title: Focus return for Modal, Drawer and Popover

results.setup: The trigger was activated as a setup action.
evidence: The modal opened and moved focus into its dialog.
After closing, focus returned to the visible button named Open.

results.setup: The trigger was activated as a setup action.
evidence: The drawer entered its open state.
Escape removed the open state after the transition.
After closing, focus returned to the visible button named Open.

results.setup: The trigger was activated as a setup action.
evidence: Escape closed the drawer after the transition.
After closing, focus returned to the visible button named Open.
All four stories render the trigger as a SPAN.
The trigger has no role and no tabindex.
Each story has zero keyboard-focusable elements before the popover opens.
A keyboard focus-return cycle cannot be initiated from the current stories.
results.requiredRemediation: Add a neutral Popover story with a native Button trigger and explicit open, Escape close and focus-return assertions.

decision: Q-04.7 was executed but remains blocked by the Popover story contract. Modal and both Drawer implementations passed focus return.
